title: Design System: Locus capture — Signal shelf

control.purpose: 14px medium labels with inherited 20px control line height.

shadows.name: segmented-active
shadows.purpose: Imported Tailwind shadow-sm on active default tabs; line detail tabs omit this.

motion.name: primitive-duration
motion.purpose: Installed Tailwind default for imported transition utilities.

motion.name: primitive-ease
motion.purpose: Installed Tailwind default for primitive transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion-duration
motion.purpose: Sample overrides animation and transition duration, one iteration, automatic scrolling.

scope.production: Existing production stylesheet retains the preceding theme; integration preserves existing business and interaction contracts.
scope.review: Current dark-only sample review covers initialization, palette consolidation and removal of theme selection; final documentation verdict is scoped to this refinement.
scope.validation: Typecheck, lint and sample build pass. Current detector advisories are unchanged contextual sizes 20px, 13px and 11px. Earlier paired-theme contrast measurements are historical evidence only.
scope.limits: No whole-application accessibility certification, real acquisition, delivery, credentials, permissions, persistence or restart-recovery verification.
scope.raster: No new shipping raster. Lucide functional vectors and nonshipping dark-only review PNGs only.
scope.tonalRamps: Eight-step OKLCH tonal ramps are synthesized preview metadata from each observed color's hue/chroma and lightness 15%–95%; they are not normative palette tokens or production CSS.

extensions.notCanonized: Unchanged contextual 20px, 13px and 11px type sizes remain bounded observations, not added type-ramp steps. The older production theme remains pending integration; historical contrast checks are not renewed accessibility claims.

narrative.overview:
Signal shelf is the selected, normative dark-only target design for Locus capture across the extension. Its first realized evidence is the standalone React sample in `design/signal-shelf`, using the installed shadcn/Base UI primitives and Lucide vectors. Existing production surfaces still carry the preceding theme; future integration must preserve the established business, state ownership and interaction contracts.

The working environment combines mineral-blue navigation, layered dark-blue list and reading surfaces, yellow-green priority actions, compact flat rows and a fixed UI sans hierarchy. It initializes with dark native controls and offers no theme switch. The personal user can scan retained summaries, inspect content and read three independent outcome facts before choosing a supported next action. The signature is a parallel outcome strip, not a sequential progress display.

Current dark-only evidence is retained in `.impeccable/review/signal-shelf-dark-only`: the five viewport/component captures and `verification.md` cover initialization, consolidated tokens, removed theme selection, narrow focus return and bounded sample behavior. Typecheck, lint and sample build pass. Earlier paired-theme contrast results are historical evidence, not a new accessibility certification; no shipping raster was added.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only mineral-blue working surfaces and native controls.
Fixed UI type roles and restrained, flat component geometry.
Parallel Capture, Local copy and Locus save facts.
Persistent reasons and supported next actions beside the content.
Separate narrow list/detail views with explicit keyboard focus return.

rules.name: The Parallel Facts Rule
rules.body: Keep Capture, Local copy and Locus save independently labeled. Do not connect them with arrows, numbers or one aggregate success claim.

rules.name: The Neutral Staging Rule
rules.body: Use the neutral outline and Inbox icon for local staging. Missing connection setup is informational; reserve error ink for an actual failed outcome.

rules.name: The UI Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the fixed UI sans hierarchy for work surfaces. Reading content gains line height and measure rather than a decorative display face.

rules.name: The Flat Working Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tonal separation and restrained strokes for the working shell. Reserve the observed lift for overlays and transient feedback.

dos: Do preserve the dark-blue material, yellow-green action priority and semantic token roles on every target surface.
Do show status as a word, a functional vector icon and a semantic color; keep staging neutral.
Do keep the three independent outcomes readable together, including when local retention fails after Locus succeeds.
Do state the supported recovery and retention limits beside the affected capture, after transient feedback disappears.
Do preserve narrow Back/focus return, named-clear confirmation, keyboard activation and reduced-motion handling.
Do keep summary search honest: it matches capture labels and source URLs in this sample.
Do use existing shadcn/Base UI variants and preserve their interaction semantics when integrating the target system.
donts: Don't imply that preview, a local copy or configuration proves a confirmed Locus save.
Don't imply that connection setup replays older captures, partial content is sent, or legacy results gain a new send capability.
Don't turn the parallel outcome strip into a wizard, a connected progress path or one generic success badge.
Don't use the synthetic toolbar, records, static progress or no-op controls as production behavior.
Don't promise restart recovery for uncommitted local content, automatic restart download continuation or cancellation by closing an inspection view.
Don't turn component inheritance or a focused contrast check into a claim of complete accessibility coverage.
Don't add decorative raster imagery, display typography or broadcast ornament to task controls.
